# Buyer Log — shared development instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and the canonical `CLAUDE.md` before editing. Every update and new
module follows `CLAUDE.md` §3.2 and `docs/PERFORMANCE_ACCEPTANCE.md`: establish the
scope and budgets first, verify the final source, and report the verdict/evidence
in `.github/pull_request_template.md`. Use the same rules locally and in Cloud;
do not introduce an independent tool-specific contract.
